title: Fix milestone checkbox interaction and ensure notes are always editable

requirements.text: Make each milestone card in MilestoneSection clickable so that clicking anywhere on the milestone header (not just the expand/collapse icon) toggles the milestone's completion status via a checkbox

quotes: no hay manera de hacer click en los hitos, como se supone que lleva esto el progreso?

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking on the milestone header area toggles a checkbox for that milestone
The checkbox state visually reflects whether the milestone is completed or not
The milestone's completion state updates immediately when clicked
Progress bars and percentages update automatically when milestones are marked complete

requirements.text: Ensure that each TaskCard component displays its notes field as an always-visible, always-editable textarea input without any collapsible/expandable behavior

quotes: no esta como te lo pedi

acceptanceCriteria: Notes textarea is visible by default on every task card
Notes textarea is immediately editable without requiring any expand/collapse action
Changes to notes are saved to the backend when the user updates them
No expand/collapse icon or button appears near the notes section

requirements.text: Verify that TaskCard checkboxes correctly toggle task completion status between completed (ON) and not completed (OFF) states, and that these changes persist to the backend

quotes: Checkboxes ON/OFF simples en cada hito

acceptanceCriteria: Each task card displays a functional checkbox
Clicking the checkbox toggles the task's completed field in the backend
The checkbox visual state (checked/unchecked) accurately reflects the backend completion status

requirements.text: Update progressUtils.ts to correctly calculate milestone, phase, and overall progress based on task completion status using the binary completed field (true/false)

quotes: Progreso general que se actualice automáticamente cuando marcas hitos

acceptanceCriteria: Progress calculations count only tasks with completed=true as complete
Progress calculations count tasks with completed=false as incomplete
Progress percentages update automatically when task completion states change
Phase progress indicators show accurate completion counts and percentages
Overall progress indicator shows accurate total project completion percentage

constraints: Do not modify backend/main.mo actor architecture or introduce multiple actors
Do not edit immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve existing task data and milestone definitions from constants/milestones.ts
Use the existing Task data model with completed field (boolean) for completion tracking
nonGoals: Reintroducing three-state status dropdown (En progreso, Terminado, Pausado)
Adding collapsible behavior to notes sections
Adding new features beyond fixing checkboxes, clickable milestones, and open notes
